name: The Distraction
text: I think you may be becoming a little bit of a distraction.

name: A Serious Problem
text: Because somehow, my mind keeps finding its way back to you.

name: The Heart
text: And honestly... I don't mind giving you a little piece of my heart.

name: And Some Back
text: Especially if you might let me keep a little piece of yours.

name: Quite A Lot
text: Actually... I wouldn't mind having quite a lot of it. ðŸ¤

name: Your Bad Days
text: When life gets heavy, I want to be someone you don't have to pretend around.

name: Even In Silence
text: Someone you can sit beside in complete silence and still feel understood.

name: I Will Annoy You
text: Of course, I also plan on being extremely annoying.

name: There Will Be Consequences
text: I understand there may be consequences for that decision.

name: Severe Consequences
text: Judging by the evidence... probably severe ones. ðŸ˜­

name: Noted
text: I'll behave. Probably.

name: Taking Care Of You
text: But beyond the jokes, I want to take care of you in all the little ways.

name: After A Long Day
text: The kind of little things that say, 'I've got you.'

name: Your Safe Place
text: I want you to know that you can always find a little peace with me. ðŸ¤

name: The Little Things
text: I want the silly things too.

name: Falling Asleep
text: The quiet nights. The sleepy conversations. The 'goodnight' that turns into another hour of talking.

name: Random Adventures
text: The random plans that somehow become our favorite memories.

name: Our Competitive Side
text: And yes... I fully intend to compete with you over things that absolutely do not matter.

name: The Sunset
text: I want to watch sunsets with youâ€”not just send them to you.

name: Quiet Evenings
text: To have those evenings where being together is enough.

name: The Pictures
text: And take way too many pictures of moments we'll one day look back on and smile about.

name: Growing Together
text: I want to see you grow into everything you're dreaming of becoming.

name: And You Watch Me
text: And I hope you'll let me grow alongside you.

name: Tomorrow
text: I don't know exactly what our story will look like.

name: Quite A Few Of Them
text: But I know there are a lot of tomorrows I'd love to share with you.

name: One Last Question
text: And after everything I've just said... there's really only one thing left to ask.
